records.title: 처음 만나는 컴퓨터
records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PNG inventory sprite for a cozy Korean library life-simulation game. Generate ONE distinct closed upright portrait book, straight front cover facing viewer, only a very thin LEFT spine and cream bottom page edge visible; absolutely no tilt or perspective rotation. Book proportions width to height about 0.84. Match a warm hand-drawn children's picture-book game style: strong consistent clean rounded dark warm-brown outlines, soft matte fills, restrained cel shading, gently rounded corners, delicate small leaf-like corner flourishes. Large simple central subject readable at 100 pixels tall. No glossy 3D, no realism, no busy textures. Isolated entire book centered with transparent padding on all sides. Actual transparent alpha background, NO ground plane, no backdrop, no haze or external drop shadow. No title text, no letters, no labels, no numbers, no watermarks. Cover in muted dusty slate-blue. Central illustration: a friendly simple desktop computer monitor, compact keyboard and small mouse, warm cream casing, small blue screen with a simple star-shaped cursor symbol. Clear everyday computer learning motif, no logos.
records.processing: Find visible book bounds using alpha>16 and add 8 source pixels of padding; crop rectangle only, preserving all original alpha inside it. Resize uniformly with Lanczos3 to 252px height, add 2px transparent padding. No painting, recoloring, compositing or per-pixel alpha thresholding.
